description: This file defines sound effect catalog and player utilities for a macOS app, including methods to list available system sounds, retrieve sounds by name or bookmark, and play sounds.

classes.name: SoundEffectPlayer
classes.description: Handles the creation and playback of sound effects using NSSound, supports loading sounds by name or URL bookmark, and manages the last played sound.

methods.name: systemOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of all discoverable system sound names, with 'Glass' pinned at the top.

methods.name: displayName(for:)
methods.description: Returns a display name for a given raw sound name.

methods.name: url(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the URL corresponding to a given sound name from the discovered sound map.

methods.name: sound(named:)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an NSSound by name, either by system name or URL.

methods.name: sound(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSSound from a bookmark data, handling security scope.

methods.name: play(_:)
methods.description: Plays the provided NSSound, stopping and updating the last sound played.
